CO Florida 2024 (COFL2024) is the Florida Department of Transportation's (FDOT's) latest version of the carbon monoxide (CO) screening model for roadway transportation.
The original COFL model (COFL2012) was developed in 2012 for the Environmental Management Office of the FDOT at the University of Central Florida (UCF) by Dr. C. David Cooper and Mark Ritner, EI. Mariano Berrios was the FDOT Project Officer.
COFL2012 was updated by Erik Cornelison and Dr. Haofei Yu at UCF. Catherine Bradley, Neil Campbell, and Terri Cook are the FDOT Project Officers.
COFL2024 replaces the previous version. It incorporated the latest version of the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency's (USEPA's) Motor Vehicle Emission Simulator (MOVES version 4), optimized dispersion modeling, and added an additional intersection option and an additional intersection type (Diverging Diamond).
Version 1.0. Published 3/3/2025. Contact: haofei.yu@ucf.edu
